question: Should native `/think` menus intentionally prefer read-only persisted/static catalog metadata over starting live provider discovery during menu construction?
rationale: The code path is narrow and likely correct, but the behavior deliberately changes the freshness/responsiveness tradeoff for existing channel users when catalog rows are absent or stale.

options.title: Accept Read-Only Menus
options.body: Land this PR after ordinary maintainer review, treating responsive native `/think` menus and persisted/static catalog metadata as the desired default.

options.title: Require Nonblocking Refresh
options.body: Ask for a follow-up in this PR that acknowledges the menu promptly and refreshes stale catalog metadata after the user-visible response.

options.title: Pause For Live Proof
options.body: Wait for Telegram Desktop or equivalent live-channel proof before accepting the behavior tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Accept Read-Only Menus
recommendation.body: Land this PR after ordinary maintainer review, treating responsive native `/think` menus and persisted/static catalog metadata as the desired default.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the predecessor runtime-catalog PR and are the best available owner for deciding whether this follow-up changes the intended catalog freshness contract.
